description: This is a Java test class containing integration tests for OAuth2 multitenancy resource server application, verifying token-based access control for different tenants and scopes.

classes.name: OAuth2MultitenancyResourceServerApplicationITests
classes.description: Test class for OAuth2 multitenancy resource server application, testing token validation and scope enforcement.

classes.name: BearerTokenRequestPostProcessor
classes.description: Helper class to add Bearer token to mock HTTP requests.

methods.name: tenantOnePerformWhenValidBearerTokenThenAllows
methods.description: Test that valid token for tenant one allows access.

methods.name: tenantOnePerformWhenValidBearerTokenWithServletPathThenAllows
methods.description: Test that valid token with specific servlet path allows access.

methods.name: tenantOnePerformWhenValidBearerTokenThenScopedRequestsAlsoWork
methods.description: Test that scoped requests for tenant one succeed with proper token.

methods.name: tenantOnePerformWhenInsufficientlyScopedBearerTokenThenDeniesScopedMethodAccess
methods.description: Test that insufficient scope token for tenant one is denied access.

methods.name: tenantTwoPerformWhenValidBearerTokenThenAllows
methods.description: Test that valid token for tenant two allows access.

methods.name: tenantTwoPerformWhenValidBearerTokenThenScopedRequestsAlsoWork
methods.description: Test that scoped requests for tenant two succeed with proper token.

methods.name: tenantTwoPerformWhenInsufficientlyScopedBearerTokenThenDeniesScopedMethodAccess
methods.description: Test that insufficient scope token for tenant two is denied access.

methods.name: invalidTenantPerformWhenValidBearerTokenThenThrowsException
methods.description: Test that an invalid tenant request with a valid token throws an exception.

methods.name: bearerToken
methods.description: Factory method to create a RequestPostProcessor that adds a Bearer token header.
